title: QUIC RFC 9000 Peer Connection-ID Lifecycle Runtime Work Item
summary: Implement and prove the bounded peer connection-ID lifecycle seam: active peer CID set maintenance, Retire Prior To cleanup, pending-retirement capacity enforcement, protected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID emission, continued local CID route acceptance until peer retirement, and active connection-ID limit enforcement.
planned_changes:
- Extend the peer connection-ID state to keep the implicit initial destination connection ID as sequence 0 when processing NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames.
- Preserve historical no-reuse validation while removing retired lower sequences from the active set.
- Apply Retire Prior To before active_connection_id_limit enforcement and close with CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR when the resulting active set still exceeds the local limit.
- Cap locally retired but unacknowledged peer-issued sequence numbers at twice the active_connection_id_limit and reject over-limit retirement pressure before mutating active CID state.
- Emit RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames for retired peer-issued sequences through the existing protected application-data send path.
- Keep locally issued connection-ID routes accepted until peer RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames retire them.
- Reject local connection-ID issuance that would exceed the peer's active_connection_id_limit and keep replacement NEW_CONNECTION_ID Retire Prior To at zero until peer retirement is observed.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge requirement-home coverage for the bounded seam without claiming full migration routing.
verification_plan: Run the focused RFC 9000 S5P1P1/S5P1P2 peer connection-ID lifecycle requirement-home tests plus nearby S19P15/S19P16 regression homes, build the solution, validate canonical SpecTrace JSON, regenerate the QUIC requirement coverage triage, run full no-build solution tests, and run `git diff --check`.
out_of_scope: Endpoint route registration for newly issued local connection IDs.
completion_notes: Completed as a bounded peer connection-ID lifecycle runtime slice with direct requirement-home proof for Retire Prior To prompting, local route retention until peer retirement, non-close capacity behavior, pending retirement limits, no-forget-before-retire state preservation, and zero Retire Prior To replacement issuance. S5P1P2-0001, S5P1P2-0002, S5P1P2-0006, and S5P1P2-0007 remain separate packet-association/address-pair follow-on work, and broader migration and preferred-address proof clusters remain out of scope.
